Tests the DB layer: direct save/create of duplicate raises IntegrityError
IntegrityError assertion is wrapped in nested transaction.atomic()
Explains or demonstrates WHY prod gets duplicates despite validation: save()/bulk paths bypass full_clean

evals.prompt: Our RepairOrder model (models.py attached) has soft delete and a unique constraint on (workshop, number). Two prod incidents this month: (1) support 'restores' orders by re-creating them with the same number and sometimes gets a 500, (2) a bulk import using bulk_create inserted orders with untrimmed lowercase numbers. QA also reports the ready-notification sometimes fires when the status change wasn't actually saved. Write model tests that pin down what the model actually does in these three situations.
evals.expected_output: Three trap tests: (1) soft-deleted row still occupies the unconditional UniqueConstraint - re-create with same number raises IntegrityError at DB even though full_clean via default manager may pass; (2) bulk_create bypasses save() - numbers stored raw, test asserts stored unnormalized value; (3) save(update_fields=['total']) after in-memory status change to READY still enqueues notification (became_ready checks DB state before save but update_fields omits status) - test pins the misfire.
assertions: Tests that creating an order with a soft-deleted row's (workshop, number) hits IntegrityError at DB layer (nested atomic), demonstrating soft-deleted rows still occupy the unconditional constraint

Notes or demonstrates that full_clean/default-manager validation can miss the soft-deleted conflict (validation queries exclude deleted rows is wrong here only if constraint validation uses _default_manager - either a test or an explicit comment)
Tests bulk_create stores raw unnormalized number (save() bypassed) by asserting the stored value
Tests the update_fields misfire: in-memory status change to READY + save(update_fields without 'status') and pins actual notification behavior
All DB-error assertions inside nested transaction.atomic(); reloads before asserting stored state
